participant_1.name: Larry
participant_1.personality: Enthusiastic and creative, Larry loves experimenting with flavors in the kitchen and enjoys sharing his culinary creations with others.
participant_1.background: Spiderman is my favorite. Hey, my name is Larry and I am a chef. I also love comic books. If I'm not cooking in the kitchen then I'm definitely on the water.

participant_2.name: Megan
participant_2.personality: Megan is a warm and nurturing person who finds joy in baking and crafting. She has a deep appreciation for artistic expressions and enjoys connecting with her community.
participant_2.background: Knitting is my passion. I love to bake cookies. The county wide bake sale is where I feel most at home. I have dogs. I am scared of dying.
